abstention.policy: Non-retrieval queries must abstain from currentness claims and expose the sealed release point when required. This fixture evaluation does not emit live legal advice.

acceptance.criteria: Sealed thresholds and differential references pass globally and per cohort; BM25, vector, hybrid, graph, filters, coverage, skew, and sparse I/O meet declared gates; defaults derive from metrics; evaluation names the exact manifest and GTE-small pin; stale fixture receipts are not full-live evidence; this report is not a live canary.

bm25.selection_reason: plan default k1=1.2 b=0.75 multi-field weights derived from LCR-027 metrics

fusion.selection_reason: plan default plan_default_weighted_0_5_0_5 meets hybrid recall gate 0.8 on dev; retained

vector.embedding_note: Fixture vectors use the local deterministic projection for offline parity; production GTE-small identity is declared by name but this gate never downloads models and cannot authorize a production-searchable claim.
vector.selection_reason: plan default probe=4 derived from LCR-029 routing bounds

currentness_disclaimer: Acquisition and publication timestamps record when a package was retrieved or sealed; they are not a claim that the codified text is legally current as of wall-clock time. Retrieval output is a research aid and is not a substitute for the official source.

fusion_selection.reason: plan default plan_default_weighted_0_5_0_5 meets hybrid recall gate 0.8 on dev; retained

sparse.notes: I/O uses a deterministic synthetic cost model so sealed reports are wall-clock independent. Routed queries must select a proper subset of shards and stay under the declared byte/shard ratios.

production_claim.claim: NO production-searchable claim: fixture uses local deterministic projection, not live GTE-small; fixture evaluation does not authorize the exact-51 release; stale fixture receipts are not full-live evidence; this report is not a live canary.

reference_hardware.notes: Sealed offline evaluation uses a deterministic synthetic cost model; numbers are comparable across commits on this fixture, not absolute production SLAs for arbitrary hardware.

reference_network.notes: LCR-036 fixture evaluation never contacts the network. Remote Hub byte budgets for live staging/canary are deferred to later release tasks and must not be inferred from this report. Stale fixture receipts are not full-live evidence.

exceptions.detail: Fixture dense vectors use the local deterministic projection (not production GTE-small). Lower vector-only relevance on citation queries is expected and is not a production embedding claim.
Exhaustive-versus-routed dense recall is measured on the local hashed projection. The 0.95 production GTE-small recall gate is not authorized by this fixture-only report.

resources.notes: Peak memory and build throughput are synthetic fixture estimates for regression tracking; they are not measured OS samples.

probes.detail: relative_path must not contain empty, '.', or '..' segments: '../etc/passwd'
relative_path must not contain empty, '.', or '..' segments: '../../secret.json'
tampered gold heading must not match sealed digest
cid does not match sha256 for data/corpus/part-000000.parquet
revision must be an immutable 40-hex Hub commit SHA, not a mutable ref: 'main'
admission payload must not contain token material
